btTracker.sub: Self-hosted BitTorrent / WebTorrent tracker for file shares
btTracker.pageDesc: Seed panel file shares over BitTorrent. Start the tracker, set a public announce host, then create BT shares in Files.
btTracker.autostartHint: Start tracker when ysk-server serve boots
btTracker.publicAnnounceHostHint: Host or host:port used in magnet announce URLs. Empty = 127.0.0.1 until you set a public hostname.
btTracker.seederPortsHint: Local peer listen range for the in-process seeder
btTracker.applyHint: Saving ports does not open the firewall — use network exposure or Start after EXECUTE.
btTracker.torrentsEmptyHint: Create a file share with BitTorrent mode in Files. This table fills as peers announce and the server seeds.
btTracker.torrentsDesc: Live swarm from the tracker, plus local seeder status for panel shares.
btTracker.announceDesc: Put these trackers in clients, or rely on magnets generated by the panel.
btTracker.needExecute: Enable system-change permission (YSK_EXECUTE) to open ports and run production seeds.
btTracker.guideBody: When you create a BT file share, YSK builds a .torrent, seeds it, and announces peers via this tracker. Open the port if downloaders are off-host.
btTracker.restoreSeedsHint: Start tracker if needed and re-seed shares that still have a .torrent on disk.
btTracker.bundledNote: Bundled with YSK Server (Node). No apt install/uninstall — Start/Stop manages the process.
btTracker.jobsEmptyHint: Large shares (≥128 MiB) build .torrent files in the background so the Files dialog stays responsive.
btTracker.jobsDesc: Background create-torrent queue for large file or folder shares.
btTracker.heroRunningSub: Peers can announce and discover seeds for panel shares.
btTracker.heroStoppedSub: Start the tracker before sharing large files over BitTorrent.
btTracker.quickStartDesc: Three steps to share files over BitTorrent.
btTracker.step2Hint: Open port exposure if peers are off this host.
btTracker.step3Hint: In Files → Share, choose BitTorrent or both.
btTracker.networkCardDesc: Where the tracker listens and what host appears in magnets.
btTracker.seederCardDesc: In-process WebTorrent seeder limits and peer ports.
btTracker.lifecycleCardDesc: Boot behaviour and how the service is packaged.
btTracker.httpPortHint: Default 8000 (YSK catalog / firewall chip). Open TCP if peers are off-host.
btTracker.udpPortHint: Optional classic UDP announce. 0 = off (browser WebTorrent uses HTTP/WS). Prefer 6969 or the same port as HTTP if you open UDP on the firewall.
btTracker.saveOkRestart: 保存済み — トラッカーを再起動してポートを適用します

help.main:
{{product}} ({{cli}}) v{{version}}

コントロール プレーン CLI — AI エージェントには --json を推奨します。
ドキュメント: docs/agent/README.md · docs/cli/reference.md · docs/agent/commands.json

使用法:
  {{cli}} <コマンド> [オプション]

コマンド:
  setup Init dataDir + admin
  update 自己更新確認・適用
  HTTP API + Web UIを提供
  system unit-install ysk-server.service をインストールします [--enable]
  ツール ツールをリストします。ツールを実行 --tool <名前> [--dry-run]
